subject.title: Suppress failed tool progress in Discord

question: Should this Discord message-delivery PR wait for retained after-fix Discord proof, or may maintainers accept the operator-observed canary report plus source-level tests?
rationale: The code path is narrow and source-backed, but the repository proof gate treats unretained operator observation as insufficient for channel-visible message-delivery changes unless a maintainer intentionally overrides it.

options.title: Wait for retained Discord proof
options.body: Require a redacted after-fix Discord transcript, recording, terminal output, or logs before merge.

options.title: Accept source-level evidence
options.body: Allow merge after branch refresh based on focused tests and the canary observation, explicitly accepting the missing retained live proof.

options.title: Pause until proof is practical
options.body: Keep the PR open but blocked until a contributor or maintainer can capture the Discord path.

recommendation.title: Wait for retained Discord proof
recommendation.body: Require a redacted after-fix Discord transcript, recording, terminal output, or logs before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has recent high-confidence ownership signals across the Discord draft-preview and shared channel-progress paths touched by this PR.
